name: Melancholic Star: I wish to sleep
source:
The guards say that «he is a improper man, just a little weirdo»

The maids say that «she is such cute girl, just like a little doll»

They wonder if there is a place where it's ok just to be…

.

.

.

What are they? Who do they want to be?

There everything feels wrong so they want to go «home»

But where is «home»?

Would be confortable there?

 

Thinking is tiring so they wish to sleep

[From [url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/melancholic-star-to-sleep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卫兵们说：“他是个不成体统的男人，就是个小怪人。”

女仆们说：“她是个多么可爱的女孩，简直像个小人偶。”

那人不禁想，是否有一个地方，可以容许自己就这样存在着……

……

自己究竟是什么？又想成为什么样的人？

这里的一切都令人感到不对劲，于是想要“回家”。

可是，“家”在哪里？

在那里，能感到自在吗？

思考太累了，于是只想睡去。

[摘自[url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/melancholic-star-to-sleep]itch.io[/url]]
